name: dsh-ops-agent
description: Oncall/ops agent lab on DeepSeek Harness + pi2dsh — pre-compaction guards (DSH-ARCH-004) and incident context preservation

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dsh-ops-agent/compaction-guard && npm run build -w @dsh-ops-agent/ops-pipeline && npm run build -w @dsh-ops-agent/code-review && npm run build -w @dsh-ops-agent/pi2dsh-plugin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dsh-ops-agent/compaction-guard && npm run test -w @dsh-ops-agent/ops-pipeline && npm run test -w @dsh-ops-agent/code-review && npm run test -w @dsh-ops-agent/pi2dsh-plugin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dsh-ops-agent/compaction-guard && npm run typecheck -w @dsh-ops-agent/ops-pipeline && npm run typecheck -w @dsh-ops-agent/code-review && npm run typecheck -w @dsh-ops-agent/pi2dsh-plugin
